title: Vedic ayanamsha default and option architecture

claims.RC-0082: Configured Vedic calculations default to the canonical Lahiri/Chitrapaksha provider id and fail closed if that provider is unavailable.
claims.RC-0083: Additional versioned ayanamsha providers can be selected explicitly through a registry without changing or coupling the independent Vedic engine.

non_claims: This contract does not by itself verify the numerical astronomy of any Lahiri implementation.
This contract does not prove rendered professional-settings UI, entitlement behavior, device evidence or release readiness.
